name: Astrid Lindström
bio:
Astrid Lindström's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport catering was a surprising turn from her early career in Michelin-starred restaurants. After years perfecting intricate tasting menus, she sought a new challenge, drawn to the fast-paced, high-pressure environment of racing. Astrid believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and she approaches her role at PEX Motorsport with the precision and attention to detail she honed in fine dining.

Her approach is rooted in providing not just sustenance, but fuel for peak performance. She meticulously plans menus tailored to individual dietary needs and energy requirements, sourcing local and sustainable ingredients whenever possible. Astrid's demanding nature stems from her commitment to excellence; she expects the same level of dedication from her team as the drivers on the track. Her insistence on perfection ensures that the PEX Motorsport team is always at their best, both on and off the track.

What sets Astrid apart is her ability to balance the refined tastes of her culinary background with the practical needs of a demanding motorsport environment. She's as comfortable negotiating with local farmers for fresh produce as she is coordinating logistics for transporting equipment across continents. Astrid's dedication to quality, coupled with her uncompromising standards, makes her an invaluable asset to PEX Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: A neat, shoulder-length bob with subtle waves.
physical.description: Astrid is a slender woman with a perpetually focused expression and a scattering of freckles across her nose.

quirks: Insists on using only Swedish-made coffee filters.
Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten recipes and ingredient lists.
Has a habit of humming classical music while inspecting the kitchen.
